captions.detailed: A travel camcorder with a dark matte finish. It features a rectangular main body, a prominent front-facing cylindrical lens barrel with a ribbed focus ring, a top-mounted carry handle, and a flat flip-out rectangular screen on the left side. A circular mode dial sits on the top surface near the rear. The flip screen rotates outward on a vertical hinge, the lens focus ring rotates continuously around the barrel, and the top mode dial rotates on its vertical axis.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a travel camcorder with a rectangular body, top handle, a cylindrical lens barrel, a left-side flip screen, and a top mode dial. The flip screen should have a revolute joint to open outward, while the focus ring on the lens and the top mode dial should have continuous rotational joints.
captions.factory: The model is built by defining a main body part using a box primitive with rounded edges, a top handle, and a fixed lens base. A separate flip screen part is modeled as a flat box and attached via a revolute joint on the left side of the body. The lens focus ring is created as a cylinder with a ribbed profile and attached to the lens barrel via a continuous joint. Finally, the top mode dial is modeled as a thin cylinder and attached to the top rear of the body with a continuous vertical joint.
